editorial:
Ever felt like you are falling behind in life? You will totally relate to Stefano, a 36-year-old who still thinks he is a rock star but has nothing to show for it. He ends up moving back to his quiet hometown in the countryside to help his family with their business, and the clash between his loud punk attitude and the slow village life is where the magic happens. It is a funny, lighthearted look at what happens when your big dreams do not pan out and you have to face the people who remember you as a kid.

The acting feels very natural, and the pacing keeps you interested without feeling rushed. While it is not a high-action flick, the charm comes from the awkward conversations and the small wins Stefano has along the way. If you love stories about underdogs finding their place, you should definitely give this a go. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to watch. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the best way to keep this gem.
endingExplained: By the end, Stefano finally stops fighting against his reality. He realizes that being a success does not always mean being a famous rock star. He finds a way to blend his rebellious spirit with his family's expectations, bringing a bit of energy to the boring town. He accepts his life in the countryside not as a defeat, but as a fresh start where he is actually appreciated by the people around him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about mid-life crises and quirky small towns.
